identity.name: Thunder Yew
identity.summary: A dark yew longbow with a forked gold branch grip.
identity.description: Costs 3 stamina per activation. Deals 16 physical damage per affordable activation. Applies 2 spark through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
identity.lore: Its tree was struck by lightning on a cloudless day.
